notesHint: Let the reels stop before you say the number. Two to four figures, no more.
description_en: Evidence scene: two to four figures spin up on odometer reels above their labels, on a single drawn horizon.
description_ko: 근거 장면. 숫자 2~4개가 오도미터 릴 위에서 돌아 멈추고, 그어진 수평선 위로 라벨이 붙는다.
responsive: Use four columns on desktop and two columns on narrow screens; wrap long labels beneath their number.
reducedMotion: Show every target number, suffix and label in its final state.
